campaign.name: Credo Legal — Competitive v1 (Meta)
campaign.notes: Consumer-debt ads require the CREDIT Special Ad Category (no age/gender/ZIP targeting, limited detailed targeting, location radius >= 15 miles). Launch PAUSED; QA before spend.

targeting_defaults.note: Whole US (operator 5 Oct 2026; was New York only). New Jersey is not targeted (operator); the other 7 are jurisdictions Credo does not serve. Florida and Texas are included (operator).

utm.note: Paste the url_parameters value into Ads Manager > Ad > Tracking > URL parameters (or use full_link as the website URL). utm_content identifies the ad and its creative version.

placement_plan.on_hold: 9:16 — 16 of 18 static 9:16 banners and the videos' burned-in strip put the disclaimer in the bottom 20% of the frame, which Stories/Reels cover with the CTA. Do not upload 9:16 until they are moved.

compliance.disclaimer_rule: brand/us-attorney-advertising-disclaimer.md (the New York disclaimer plus what other states add)
compliance.in_primary_text: Every primary text ends with the nationwide disclaimer; do not edit or shorten it.
compliance.in_creative: Competitive v1 images carry the New York disclaimer line and its videos the AI-performer disclosure strip; the Debt Defense v4 creatives carry none. The full nationwide text is in the primary text of every ad.
held_creatives: CC_Lawsuit (Bold "fist"): baked line "You have 20 to 28 days to answer." is not true in every state
Collection_Lawsuit (Bold "fist"): baked line "You have 20 to 28 days to answer." is not true in every state
Creditor_Suing (Bold "fist"): baked line "You have 20 to 28 days to answer." is not true in every state
Served_Papers (Bold "fist"): baked line "You have 20 to 28 days to answer." is not true in every state
FDCPA_Harassment (Bold "pointing"): baked line "up to $1,000 per violation" overstates the FDCPA (the cap is per lawsuit); render glitch "FREE.E."
Multiple_Collectors (Bold "pointing"): baked line "up to $1,000 per violation" overstates the FDCPA (the cap is per lawsuit); render glitch "FREE.E."
Medical_Lawsuit (Bold "fist"): baked line "You have 20 to 28 days to answer." is not true in every state
before_launch: Responsible attorney pre-approves every ad (NY Rule 7.1(k)).
Keep a copy of each ad (New York: at least one year for online ads; the attorney sets the period for other states).
Confirm the entity name (Credo Legal Services, P.C.).
